title: Animated Menubar
subtitle: A row of menus, like an app's File and Edit menus.

descriptions.animation: How a menu opens from its trigger.
descriptions.exitFast: Menus close faster than they open (60% of Duration).
descriptions.switchAnimation: What happens when you move to the next menu while one is open: the panel glides across, or closes and reopens.
descriptions.contentAnimation: How the new menu's items appear while the panel glides. Needs Moving over set to Glide.
descriptions.slideDistance: How far items slide in when switching menus. Needs Moving over set to Glide and Content animation set to Slides in.
descriptions.duration: How long opening, closing and gliding take, in seconds.
descriptions.delay: Wait before the items start to appear, in seconds.
descriptions.stagger: Delay between one item appearing and the next, in seconds.
descriptions.triggerHighlight: Highlight that follows the pointer along the menu bar.
descriptions.triggerHighlightColor: Colour of the bar highlight. Not used when Menu highlight is None.
descriptions.showChevrons: Shows a chevron next to each menu name that turns when it opens.
descriptions.triggerRollingText: Menu names roll to a second copy of themselves on hover.
descriptions.openOnClick: Menus open on click only; hovering the bar doesn't open them.
descriptions.pressFeedback: Menu names squeeze slightly when pressed.
descriptions.itemHighlight: Highlight on the item under the pointer inside a menu.
descriptions.itemHighlightColor: Colour of the item highlight. Not used when Item highlight is None.
descriptions.selectionIndicator: Mark shown next to chosen options in checkbox and radio items.
descriptions.showIcons: Shows an icon before each item.
descriptions.showDescriptions: Shows a second line of help text under items that have one.
descriptions.rollingText: Item labels roll to a second copy on hover.
descriptions.size: Text and padding size of the bar and menus.
descriptions.rounded: Corner radius of the bar, the menus and their items.
